level: Stage 1 (Volcano), Vic Viper controllable, 3 lives, weapon/options/shield 0
genre: horizontal auto-scrolling shoot-'em-up (forced scroll = progress; ship screen-X is NOT progress)
method: scripted (noop / right / left / up / down / right+B / down+right suicide) + seeded-random rollouts from the receipted start state on THIS core, frame_skip 1 for clean per-frame arcs. Full 2KB scanned per frame. Differential + wrap + saturation + frame-counter-pause + checkpoint-reset analysis of OUR OWN RAM traces. No external maps or disassembly.

step1_in_gameplay.note: 78 >> 25 on $00A4 (plus the OAM ship sprites $0207.. and the X-trail $07A0-$07AF all diverge with direction). Start state confirmed live in-gameplay.

receipts.monotone_while_alive: nondec=1.000, zero backward jumps over every scripted first life: 11->836 (deep suicide life), 11->429 (shallow noop life), 11->161 (fwd life).
receipts.frame_counter_rejection: $003E FREEZES during the death/explosion pause (68,68,0,0,0,0...) exactly when the world stops scrolling, whereas the genuine free-running frame counter $0002 counts straight through the same death (56,57,58...66). Scroll-linked, not a fixed-cadence clock. Per-frame counters $0002/$0036 REJECTED.
receipts.depth_dependent_checkpoint_reset: resets to the WORLD checkpoint on death, depth-dependent: shallow death (noop @837, fwd @301) -> accumulator 0 (start checkpoint); deep suicide death (@1652, @1857) -> accumulator 512 (page-2 checkpoint). A fixed-respawn byte would reset to the same value regardless of death depth (that is what $00F5/$00F6/$00B8/$00D5 do -> those REJECTED).
receipts.saturation_test: PASS. $003F keeps STEPPING across screens (reached page 3 in a 1652-frame life, page 12 = accumulator 3132 under Go-Explore) and does NOT cap. Contrast the camera byte $006D which CLAMPS at 240 (the Kirby camera-clamp failure mode) -> $006D REJECTED as progress, together with jittery $006E and the cyclic 0-255 scroll-fine copies $0012/$0048 (wrap every ~512 frames, no clean saturation-proof page).
receipts.auto_scroll_input_independent: $003E advances at the same ~+1 / 2-frame rate under noop and under forward input -> it is the stage's FORCED scroll, not player-driven.

player_x.role: documented (NOT progress on an auto-scroller); RIGHT+ LEFT- div 78 [VERIFIED-LIVE]

y.receipt: VERIFIED-LIVE vertical: up- (216->57) / down+ (216->135); head of the Y-trail $07C0-$07CF (which mirror it, e.g. $0320 OAM-Y). Range >130 across up/down. Critical y-band for a dodge-heavy shmup.

lives.receipt: VERIFIED-LIVE 3 at spawn; steps 3->2->1->0 EXACTLY on each death (noop6000 @837/1727/2617; suicide3000 @1652/1857/2062), then wraps to 255 at game-over. start_lives=3 => is_dead fires on the first life lost. Robust across bullet/collision/terrain deaths.

death.player_state_rejected: the config ram_mapping's status $0100 is FALSIFIED as a death byte: it reads 2 during NORMAL alive play (fwd1500 frames 200/300/600/900/1000/1300 with lives still 3/2/1) — wiring it into solve.player_state would abort live bursts on phantom deaths. It also sits in the 6502 stack page $0100-$01FF (execution scratch). OMITTED; lives-only death is clean and correct here.

out_travels_random.verdict: PASS — Go-Explore reaches 2.8x further into the stage than plain random with the identical action distribution. Random dies 1591 times and always restarts from the entrance, so it cannot accumulate past a single lucky life (~1116); Go-Explore banks deep-survival states and returns to them (first-return-then-explore), pushing the forced-scroll frontier to 3132. This is the real validation that the chosen progress signal is being exploited.
